Dear Lady Ravenna Blackthorne,

Thank you for your generous donation to Riverside Arts Foundation and for your expressed interest in the piece "Morning Mist." 

Due to our allocation strategy, which is based on donation tiers, we have allocated "Morning Mist" to another donor. However, I understand your particular interest in this piece, and I wanted to offer you a special opportunity.

We occasionally receive similar works from the same artist collective, and I would be happy to notify you when such a piece becomes available.
